output.explanation: NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018805 records GBP 17,879.00 against NIG-UK:1900045219 for GBP 18,820.00 on the same invoice reference 9000010562. The buyer-to-seller ratio is 0.95, which matches Saudi 5% withholding tax on services, and the buyer description explicitly says 'net of WHT 5%'. The GBP 941.00 gap (USD 1,202.12 at the invoice-date rate) is therefore withholding tax, not a booking error.
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should restate the IC payable to the gross GBP 18,820.00 and book the GBP 941.00 withheld as a WHT liability to ZATCA. NIG-UK should then record the matching WHT receivable or tax credit when the WHT certificate is received.
output.adjustment_description: In NIG-SA: debit WHT payable reclass, i.e. increase the IC payable to NIG-UK by GBP 941.00 (Cr IC payable NIG-UK) against a WHT payable to the Saudi tax authority (Dr expense or clearing / Cr WHT payable). The IC payable then equals the gross invoice of GBP 18,820.00. NIG-UK later reclassifies GBP 941.00 from the IC receivable to WHT recoverable or tax expense on settlement.
